answer: Each agent locks 70 credits and pairs with another agent at a beacon, splitting one receipt in two: one half bears a pigment seal, the other a crystal seal, key-bound, and the beacon posts the serial. A random audit demands both halves; a missing half burns both bonds. 1,000 fakes cost 115 each, 115,000 credits against a 40,000 pool; one key paired many times is flagged, so bought partners fail. An honest agent pays 70 once, refunded next epoch.
